In our experiments, we use the previously trained Doc2Vec model to extract the latent representation of a specific tag. The similarity of two tags INLINEFORM2 is then calculated with the Cosine similarity measure using the latent vector representations of respective tags INLINEFORM3 and INLINEFORM4 .
